title: Miami Sunshine Summer Store
tagline: Full-stack neo-brutalist e-commerce web platform built with React, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Stripe payments.
summary: Vibrant full-stack MERN e-commerce application featuring JWT authentication, Redux Toolkit state persistence, infinite scroll catalog pagination, dynamic search & filtering, and secure Stripe payment processing.
overview: Miami Sunshine Summer Store is a high-energy, full-stack MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) e-commerce web application engineered with a distinctive neo-brutalist coastal aesthetic. Built from the ground up to provide seamless customer browsing and lightning-fast transactions, the platform integrates Redux Toolkit for unified global state (cart, user sessions, active filters, and cached catalog pages), an infinite-scroll product catalog with backend cursor-style pagination and case-insensitive regex filtering, bcrypt-secured JWT authentication with customized user profiles and badge identifiers, and an end-to-end Stripe Checkout Sessions payment integration guarded by Express rate limiting and CORS controls.
problem: Traditional e-commerce templates often suffer from sluggish page transitions, fragile state synchronization between cart and checkout, generic corporate visuals, and repetitive database refetches when users navigate between product detail views and catalog lists.
solution: Designed and implemented an expressive, neo-brutalist MERN web application utilizing Redux Toolkit to cache catalog queries and maintain cart consistency, an asynchronous Express & Mongoose backend providing paginated REST endpoints, rate-limited Stripe payment sessions, and a mobile-first responsive React frontend with Intersection Observer infinite loading.
architectureHighlights: Full-Stack MERN Architecture: Decoupled React + Vite frontend communicating with a RESTful Express 5 & Mongoose backend
Redux Toolkit State Caching: Global store retaining fetched products, active category filters, and search terms to eliminate redundant network roundtrips
Infinite Scroll & Cursor Pagination: Seamless browsing powered by react-intersection-observer paired with backend skip() and limit() database queries
Stripe Checkout Integration: Secure server-side checkout session creation formatting multi-item line items with automatic shipping threshold logic
JWT Authentication & Security: Bearer token authentication with bcrypt 10-round password hashing, persistent profile state, and route guards
API Resilience & Rate Limiting: Configured Express Rate Limit middleware (5 req/min on sensitive routes) preventing credential stuffing and checkout abuse
keyFeatures: Dynamic Catalog Filtering: Real-time search and multi-category filtering ('Surf Gear', 'Apparel', 'Accessories', 'Limited') across MongoDB collections
Redux-Powered Shopping Cart: Persistent client-side cart with real-time subtotal calculations and free-shipping threshold logic ($100+)
Neo-Brutalist Visual Design: Custom coastal theme with hard drop shadows, high-contrast neon accents, sticker badges, and tactile button feedback
User Account Management: Dedicated member dashboard featuring order history tracking, shipping address updates, and customizable status badges
One-Click Card Checkout: Instant redirect to Stripe Hosted Checkout with automated currency handling and order metadata tracking
Transactional Messaging: Contact and support inquiry pipelines powered by backend email dispatch services

title: Leaf Diagnostics: Tomato Disease Classifier
tagline: Custom deep PyTorch CNN & FastAPI web system diagnosing tomato leaf health and 5 plant pathologies with 95.1% accuracy.
summary: Deep learning computer vision system trained on 10,900+ leaf images, delivering real-time probabilistic diagnosis across 6 tomato leaf conditions via a lightweight FastAPI REST backend.
overview: Leaf Diagnostics is an end-to-end computer vision platform designed to provide accessible plant disease screening for farmers and agriculturalists. Powered by a custom 5-stage Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) built and trained from scratch in PyTorch on a curated corpus of ~10,900 images from PlantVillage and the Pakistan Tomato Leaf datasets, the model classifies tomato leaves into six distinct categories: healthy leaves, Early Blight (Alternaria solani), Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans), Leaf Mold (Passalora fulva), Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV), and Septoria Leaf Spot (Septoria lycopersici). The solution pairs an asynchronous Python FastAPI inference microservice with a responsive Netlify web application equipped with client-side canvas pre-compression, real-time scanning feedback, and an interactive held-out sample test gallery.
problem: Plant diseases like Early Blight, Late Blight, and Yellow Leaf Curl Virus spread aggressively across tomato crops, often causing catastrophic yield loss. Traditional laboratory diagnosis is accurate but expensive and slow, creating an information lag that prevents farmers from taking timely containment measures.
solution: Built a free, rapid screening tool powered by a custom deep PyTorch CNN reaching 95.1% validation accuracy. The system features a rate-limited Python FastAPI REST backend with Torchvision image preprocessing and a responsive web client enabling farmers to upload photos directly from mobile devices or evaluate against held-out sample images.
architectureHighlights: Custom 5-stage Conv2D + MaxPool2d feature extractor progressively downsampling 224×224 RGB inputs to 6,272 features
3-stage fully connected classification head (6,272 → 512 → 128 → 6 logits) with Softmax probability normalization
Multi-source training dataset combining 10,900+ images from PlantVillage (clean morphology) and Pakistan Tomato Leaf (field conditions)
Preserved 3-channel RGB color space to capture pigmentation shifts, chlorosis, and lesion discoloration critical to diagnosis
Data augmentation pipeline applying on-the-fly random flips, brightness/contrast shifts, and ±20° rotations
Asynchronous FastAPI REST endpoint (POST /predict) with SlowAPI rate limiting (5 req/min) for DDoS and compute protection
Client-side HTML5 canvas image downscaling to 400px before transmission to optimize mobile data bandwidth
keyFeatures: Multi-Class Disease Screening: Differentiates healthy leaves from 5 widespread fungal and viral diseases
Granular Probability Readout: Generates sorted Softmax confidence percentages and visual meters for all 6 target classes
Interactive Held-Out Sample Gallery: Includes a built-in collection of unseen test samples for each class for instant live demonstration
Mobile-First Responsive Interface: Direct touch-to-upload and camera capture with animated scanning state indicators
High-Performance Inference: Optimized PyTorch inference pipeline operating with torch.no_grad() for sub-200ms turnaround

Empirical Hyperparameter Tuning: Checkpointed training pipeline optimized with Adam optimizer (learning rate 0.0005) and cross-entropy loss, achieving 95.1% validation accuracy and 0.13 validation loss
